# Native correction-notice authoring fixtures

Exact final generated bytes come from signed Report `66dc819432c137cb7f160ce8f685db0051b4a16b`,
tree `db10688adb067aa8bab8ee4ce586d9b620dd5475`. The final frozen handoff manifest SHA256 is
`48e1419b103be49a80dbc0998e9de0805a1f063e2538b92e912b0be6f82e014f`; its generated manifest,
retained here unchanged, hashes to
`c90bd5a91e2c629885cbcb9f1927f855f0641dfe668e47f4bdffc790695258b9`.
[Report owner reconciliation](https://github.com/sgajbi/lotus-render/issues/352#issuecomment-6160530253)
and [consumer scope decision](https://github.com/sgajbi/lotus-render/issues/352#issuecomment-6230039944)
bind this adoption.

Historical qualification remains attached to Report `2275b3fb3aae8df56e3972c12dc4a623f450cbff`,
tree `314181b9dce7565523b88579e4860114fab11c05`, and Render `61b6fbbdc08ff6b255bbc2cdabe12af33d906eb1`.
Its [original relay](https://github.com/sgajbi/lotus-report/issues/446#issuecomment-6116208752)
handoff hashes to `9713fb7588f9458c0b5de3069ed858cb2bcbe89762e664b9c38f95140c13aa8d`, with generated
manifest `743370185be46a9e6b70c3631abed1e93cebdd6f62e34aa9a2a993c2782e50ab`. Those historical
committed fixtures and sealed evidence remain available; they are not repinned as final-producer runs.

Each `.json.gz` decompresses to the original byte count and SHA in that manifest; compression
uses mtime zero. The two unmodified generated schemas are under `src/app/contracts/notice_schemas`.
Tests verify every imported byte pin, all nine canonical preimages and semantic refusals.

Of the 34 generated artifacts, 32 remain byte-identical to the historical cohort, including the
full package, projection, custody schema and all nine known answers. Only the v9 schema and
producer-budget proof changed; the latter updates agreement text without changing numerical limits
or measurements. Final v9 schema SHA256:
`6a28e4365931ac1df34419003861582339b08219fcdac936378b822ed483b9b4`.

These are controlled retained historical inputs and a synthetic own notice capture/relationship
record, not current source authority, an Archive197 API read or a joined runtime result. The final
schema embeds the native Archive relationship DTO accepted at `036c14127369c99f28448d253d4495a1ae2b58c3`.
That DTO's wider identifier field space does not expand Render's 256-character profile limits;
the existing typed relationship validator also enforces aware timestamps independently of optional
JSON Schema format support. Offline schema/KAT correspondence does not prove API, authority,
audit, storage or PostgreSQL behavior. The original r5
specification/recipe remain governing except for the reviewed r6 immutable economic relationship
record amendment. No financial, materiality, approval or recipient authority is added.

The producer plan matches all 35 other logical tables. Its ArtifactIdentity uses a placeholder
template digest and a different rounding description/order. Render preserves its established
identity field order/text, supplies its real layout digest and appends the exact six notice
fields. This explains the seven-byte planner text difference; receiver measurements include all
actual cells, repeated headers, context chunks and pinned data.
